verdict.rationale: Notte is built for programmatic, unattended use. Cloud browser sessions are controlled through an API with Bearer-token auth, a CLI drives browsers from shell commands, and Playwright can connect over CDP. Scripts can also be deployed as serverless functions that are invoked and scheduled anywhere, which covers headless automation well. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or pipeline examples) and independent hands-on corroboration of headless or CI runs.
